integrity: Reproducible exact finite-state enumeration and polynomial identities are supplied as a standalone Python 3 standard-library checker; no external audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact two-refuge theorem on a three-to-five-site periodic zero-field Ising habitat model; no landscape calibration, reserve costs, empirical forecasts, or larger-graph classification. Historical priority remains subject to independent verification.
title: Five habitats are sharp for a mean–tail reserve-placement conflict under spatially correlated losses
